steps.title: पहले कीमत और पैमाना
steps.body: कोटेशन में दोनों भुगतान से पहले तय होते हैं। बाद में कोई नहीं बदलता।

steps.title: निजी जानकारी, आपके ब्राउज़र में
steps.body: Prepare स्क्रीन उसे हटाती है और फ़ाइल को ऐसी कुंजी से बंद करती है जो सिर्फ़ आपके पास है।

steps.title: ट्रेनिंग से पहले बने उदाहरण
steps.body: जब हम आपके उदाहरणों से और लिखते हैं, आप नमूना देखकर मंज़ूर, दोबारा या रद्द करते हैं।

steps.title: नियम से रिफ़ंड
steps.body: जो मॉडल आपका पैमाना चूके, उसका पूरा रिफ़ंड होता है, माँगे बिना।

how.title: काम बताने से अपना मॉडल मिलने तक, चार कदम।

steps.title: काम बताइए
steps.body: अपने शब्दों में बताइए, हिंदी, हिंग्लिश या अंग्रेज़ी में। असिस्टेंट सही रेसिपी चुनता है।

steps.title: कुछ उदाहरण लाइए
steps.body: बीस से पचास काफ़ी हैं। कुछ भी भेजे जाने से पहले निजी जानकारी आपके ब्राउज़र में हट जाती है।

steps.title: हम ट्रेन करते हैं और जाँचते हैं
steps.body: खाली पड़े डिवाइस मॉडल ट्रेन करते हैं। उसे आपके अपने टेस्ट में पास होना है और बिना ट्रेन वाले मॉडल से बेहतर भी, वरना रिफ़ंड।

steps.title: इस्तेमाल कीजिए या घर ले जाइए
steps.body: API के रूप में होस्ट कराइए, या डाउनलोड करके अपनी मशीन पर चलाइए। दोनों तरह से आपको दिखता है कि कितनी बचत हुई।

faqs.a: A way for a small business to get its own small AI model for one job, like sorting support tickets or reading invoices. Idle gaming PCs and laptops do the training, and you pay only if the model passes your test.

faqs.q: How much data do I need?
faqs.a: Between 20 and 50 examples of the right answer. Some are kept aside, unseen, to test the model before you pay.
Hindi, Hinglish and English. Two of the first five jobs, support tickets and clinic questions, are built around Hinglish.

faqs.q: What if the model isn't good enough?
faqs.a: Then you don't pay. It has to pass your test and beat the untrained model; if it misses either, the whole budget is refunded automatically.

faqs.q: Can I use it for my business today?
faqs.a: Not yet for real money. Ekido runs on a public test network with test money until an independent audit.

docs.baseBody: Every endpoint below starts with this address.
docs.authBody: Create a key in Settings → API keys, then send it as a Bearer token. Keys belong to your team and can be revoked at any time.
docs.modesBody: ek_test_ keys use test payments and the test network, and cost nothing. ek_live_ keys come with real payments; this build accepts test mode only.
docs.endpointsLead: Each one says honestly whether it works today. Requests and answers are JSON; personal details never travel in a URL.

endpoint.me: Who you are, and the teams this key or sign-in can use
endpoint.recipes: The ready-made tasks you can train, with their columns and quality bar
endpoint.datasets: Upload your examples for a recipe; every row problem comes back at once
endpoint.quotes: Price, GST and the quality bar for a dataset, before you pay
endpoint.orders: Start a test payment for a quote (Razorpay Checkout)
endpoint.jobs: Start training from a paid quote
endpoint.invoice: The GST invoice for a paid order, as a PDF
endpoint.job: A job's progress, as you see it (devices are never named)
endpoint.predict: Run your model on up to 32 inputs
endpoint.download: A short-lived link to download your model

auth.owner: A signed-in team owner or admin

docs.goldenLead: The steps that work today with a test key. Paying and starting the job follow once test payments are switched on.
docs.predictLead: Once your model passes its test, this is all it takes. Your text is never logged.
docs.errorsBody: Errors come back as JSON with an error code and a detail sentence you can show to a person. 401 means sign in or send a key; 404 means not found, or not yours; 422 lists what to fix; 429 means slow down.

train.title: Train your model
train.lead: Bring examples of the job you want done. You'll see the price and the quality bar before you pay, and if the model misses the bar, you get your money back.
train.signInTitle: Sign in to train a model
train.signInLead: Your models belong to your team.
train.teamLead: Models, keys and invoices belong to a team.
train.recipeLead: Each task has a fixed format and a quality bar.
train.fileLead: A CSV file with the columns {input} and {answer}. Add a column called split (train or test) to choose the test examples yourself; otherwise every fifth row is held back for the test.
train.privacyNote: Remove names, phone numbers and other personal details from your examples before you upload them. They're sent to Ekido and to the devices that train your model.
train.tooLarge: This file is larger than 20 MB. Use fewer or shorter examples.
train.needTest: The quality check needs at least 20 test examples; this file gives {have}. Add more rows.
train.provisional: Prices are provisional while Ekido is in test mode.
train.testMode: Test mode: use Razorpay's test UPI or test card. No real money moves.
train.paymentFailed: The payment didn't go through. Nothing was charged; try again.
train.paymentSlow: We haven't heard from Razorpay yet. If you paid, your training starts as soon as it confirms; check back in a minute.
train.heldFor: {n, plural, one {This price is held for 1 more minute.} other {This price is held for # more minutes.}}
train.expired: This price has expired. Get a new one; your examples are kept.
train.dropTitle: Drop your CSV file here, or choose one
train.dropHint: A .csv file, up to {mb} MB. It stays on this device until you press Upload.
train.dropActive: Drop it to use this file
train.dropWrongType: {file} isn't a CSV file. Choose a file that ends in .csv.
train.dropTooBig: {file} is larger than {mb} MB. Use fewer or shorter examples.
train.dropEmpty: {file} is empty. Choose the file with your examples.

job.title: Your model
job.notFound: There's no such job in your team.

stageLead.starting: Finding a device to train on.
stageLead.checking: Independent checkers are testing your model on your test examples.
stageLead.passed: Your model passed its quality bar and is ready.
stageLead.refunded: Your model missed its quality bar, so you get a full refund.

job.moved: {n, plural, one {A device dropped out once; the training carried on from its last checkpoint on another device.} other {Devices dropped out # times; each time the training carried on from its last checkpoint on another device.}}
job.qualityPending: Your model must answer at least {floor}% of your test examples correctly.
job.qualityPassed: {score}% of your test examples answered correctly. The bar was {floor}%: passed.
job.qualityMissed: {score}% of your test examples answered correctly. The bar was {floor}%: missed, so you're refunded.

payment.HELD: {amount} paid and held until the check passes.

job.modelLead: Download it to run anywhere, or call it with your API key.
